title: Pointer Indexing Pipeline
goal: Chain raw pointer arithmetic to read the third element of an array.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Unsafe Rust

hints: First obtain a raw pointer from the slice using as_ptr().
Advance the raw pointer by 2 elements, then dereference target with *.
explanation: To read through raw pointer arithmetic, you must first obtain a `*const u16` using `as_ptr()`, advance it by 2 elements using `ptr.add(2)`, and finally dereference `*target`. Out of order evaluation fails compilation with `E0425` because variable names are not yet defined in scope.
